en.description:
Brick Breaker: Watch Arcade now has Wrist Rankings: a global leaderboard and six achievements, so you can see how your best run stacks up. Bounce, smash, and chase a new high score entirely on your wrist, no phone required.

Every run is saved locally first, so you can keep playing offline - Wrist Rankings syncs automatically the moment you're back online.

> What's inside:
> - Wrist Rankings: a global leaderboard, six achievements, and a chart of your recent scores
> - Siri support: say "Play Brick Breaker," "Check my best score," or "Toggle endless mode"
> - Endless mode: clear a board and a faster wave respawns instead of the run ending
> - Digital Crown paddle control, tuned for quick, precise reflexes
> - A hand-drawn "neon sketchbook" redesign, with living animated moments throughout
> - Fully playable offline, with haptic feedback and Dynamic Type support

Whether you're a retro arcade fan or brand new to brick breakers, Brick Breaker: Watch Arcade is built to be played entirely on your Apple Watch - quick sessions, satisfying bounces, and now, bragging rights.
en.releaseNotes:
New: Wrist Rankings - a global Game Center leaderboard and six achievements, with a chart of your recent scores. Every run still saves locally first and syncs automatically once you're signed in.

New: Siri support - say "Play Brick Breaker," "Check my best score," or "Toggle endless mode" right from your wrist.

A complete visual redesign: a hand-drawn "neon sketchbook" look with living animated moments on the start screen and after every run.

Fixed the start screen background artwork, which was missing in a previous update.

Built with the latest watchOS SDK.
en.subtitle: Global Wrist Leaderboards
